title: Best Arabic Catering Companies Dubai: What to Compare
body_markdown:
Arabic catering in Dubai can range from a generous mezze table to a wedding buffet or a family meal built around traditional rice and grilled dishes. Compare the regional menu, presentation and service against the occasion you are planning.

## About this guide

This guide is published by myCHEF, a provider of private chef and catering services. It compares service formats and practical selection criteria. Individual providers should be assessed through their current proposals, relevant documentation and suitability for your occasion.

## Choose the menu direction

Levantine mezze, charcoal grills, rice dishes and regional sweets offer different ways to structure the table. Tell the provider which traditions and dishes matter to your guests, and ask for a balanced menu rather than a long list of unrelated choices.

## Plan the centrepiece and the service

An ouzi centrepiece, live grill or staffed buffet needs suitable space, equipment and a service plan. A smaller sharing dinner may work with a more compact team. Confirm how bread, hot dishes and desserts will be replenished.

## Confirm sourcing and guest needs

Discuss halal sourcing, any requested documentation and dietary requirements before the menu is approved. Check whether drinks, Arabic coffee, service staff and tableware are included, and compare the complete written quote.

## Questions to ask before confirming

Request a written menu and scope, confirm the guest count and service hours, and check which staff, equipment and extras are included. Share dietary requirements before approving the menu. Review the payment schedule, change deadlines and cancellation terms, and identify the contact who will coordinate the booking.

## Explore the myCHEF service

If Arabic catering suits your plans, explore the service details and published options below. Share your date, Dubai location, guest count and preferences so the team can assess availability and prepare a tailored proposal. The written booking confirms the final menu, responsibilities and price.

[Explore Arabic catering](/arabic-catering-dubai) · [Request a proposal](/inquiry)
